summary: Stripe TEST-MODE payment integration fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_payments.py: (1) POST /api/payments/stripe/checkout as loyaltytest@airyatra.com with booking_id=test-stripe-inquiry-1 returns real checkout_url on checkout.stripe.com, session_id starting cs_test_, amount=25000.0, advance_percent=50 — server-computed (client cannot set amount). (2) same endpoint without auth -> 401/403. (3) same booking hit by employee token (different customer) -> 403. (4) checkout on already-paid test-voucher-inquiry-1 -> 400 'Already paid / भुगतान पहले हो चुका है'. (5) invalid booking id -> 404. (6) GET /api/payments/stripe/status/{session_id} on newly created (unpaid) session -> 200, payment_status='pending', amount=25000. (7) status on cs_test_invalid_xyz -> 404. (8) status endpoint requires no auth (public poll). Frontend E2E (Playwright, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): login as loyaltytest@airyatra.com -> /customer/payment/test-stripe-inquiry-1 -> PaymentPage shows payable-amount ₹25,000 (50% advance of ₹50,000) + 'Secured by Stripe (Test Mode)' label -> pay-now-btn -> redirected to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... -> filled Stripe test form (email test@airyatra.com, card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/34, CVC 123, name Test User, postal 400001) -> hosted-payment-submit-button -> redirected back to /payment/success?session_id=cs_test_a1CiBJ0lGTjRy... -> payment-paid-icon visible with '₹25,000 paid' text + 'भुगतान सफल — booking confirmed!' -> view-booking-btn navigates to /customer/inquiry/test-stripe-inquiry-1. Backend DB verification via motor: inquiry test-stripe-inquiry-1 now has payment_status=paid, status=confirmed, payment_gateway=stripe_test, paid_at set, payment_session_id set. payment_transactions has 3 docs for this booking (2 abandoned pending sessions from earlier attempts + the completed one) — exactly 1 doc with payment_status=paid (idempotent). Idempotency confirmed: 3 successive GET /api/payments/stripe/status/{paid_session} returns identical paid response, no dup writes. Re-creating checkout on same now-paid booking returns 400 'Already paid'. Backend logs clean (only benign passlib bcrypt warning). Regression: /operator/erp loads with maintenance-alerts-panel + fuel-tracking-panel + compliance-docs-panel; /employee portal loads for employee@airyatra.com; /hr admin dashboard loads with 25 employees / 22 present / 3 on leave / 8 field active.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_payment_routes._get_stripe uses request.base_url for webhook_url — behind Kubernetes ingress this may resolve to internal 0.0.0.0:8001 URL; Stripe webhook delivery won't reach it. Consider setting WEBHOOK_BASE_URL env override.

stripe_payment_routes.create_stripe_checkout re-computes amount as float(int(total*pct/100)) — the int() truncates paise. Fine for INR whole-rupee amounts, but a comment or explicit rounding (round()) would be clearer.
PaymentPage still shows 'Select Payment Method' UI (UPI/Card/Netbanking) that has no effect on the flow — Stripe handles method selection on hosted page. Remove or hide to avoid customer confusion.
seed_data_creation: Paid test-stripe-inquiry-1 (₹25,000) via real Stripe test-mode checkout — inquiry is now confirmed+paid. Created 3 payment_transactions rows for this booking (2 pending from checkout tests + 1 paid completed). Booking confirmation email was sent to loyaltytest@airyatra.com via real SMTP (expected 1x per problem statement). For re-testing, test-stripe-inquiry-1 will now fail checkout with 'Already paid' — need a new unpaid seed inquiry.
